m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: The Fountain of Night lets me craft you a new style of weapon! Before now, only the Shadow Queen's elite had access to my arms.
I believe I am the first in the Spiral to craft this kind of magic. You need it for your crusade to tear down the Shadow Queen.
However, in return you must find any Mantis Tributes that are in the Hive, and release them. Agreed?
Thank you. Take this weapon, now steeped in Shadow. Look in the City of Sardonyx if you ever need to find me again.
Hrum. A fine weapon. It could be a help in the upcoming battles, for many of your foes will be well-versed in Shadow magic.
It took Morganthe many years of study to learn Shadow magic, and she quickly surpassed the Spider Magi who taught her.
Still, she was reluctant to share what she had learned, until her power bloomed with the infusion of a great rush of Death magic.
Now that Morganthe is saturated with power, she hands it out easily to any who might defeat you. You should be honored. Hrum.
<ITALICS>You hold the Night Orb up towards the fountain. There's a tremendous rush of wind and energy. </ITALICS>
<ITALICS>You sense, see, taste, hear, smell, and feel power being pulled from the immense Shadow Web and pooling here. </ITALICS>
Well done! Any who wish to study the ebb and flow of Shadow can study here, and can drink deep of its depths.
It will take generations for the Shadow Web to be drained of its reservoir, but the Arachna Magi no longer hold all the cards.
The Night Orb is a drop of Shadow magic frozen in physical form. It is night, and dark, and chaos you can hold in your hand.
The Night Orb is a conduit to the Shadow Web. On its own, it could give an individual the gift of Shadow magic without study.
Hrum. But we can instead embed it here, to allow others to tap into the river of magic.
Wizard, use the Night Orb to make the Fountain of Night flow. Then speak to Azealia the ArmsMaster.
Restore the Fountain of Night, then speak to Azealia the ArmsMaster.
